newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Saiag buys Alcatel unit.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Saiag buys Alcatel unit.

text.p: Italy's Saiag Group said it has acquired French Alcatel unit Barelec S.A., an electric cable producer, in a deal worth 70 million French francs.
Barelec will be controlled by Saiag's Patelec, its cable and flex sub-holding, a company statement said.

With the acquisition of Barelec, Patelec will have a total annual production capacity of over 90 million electric cables with pre-fused and attached plugs, becoming European leader in the sector with a market share of over 20 percent, Saiag managing director Giovanni Poletto said.
Saiag, which entered the electric cable and flex sector with the purchase of Patelec in 1986, expects to see a sector turnover of 200 billion lire in 1997.
The Saiag group, which operates in the rubber components sector, had first half 1996 net profit of 12.1 billion lire on revenues of 400 billion lire.
